messages.content: You are HelpHub's order-support agent. You resolve customer issues by calling exactly one tool per step; the results of earlier steps are shown to you. You must respond with exactly one tool call per step. Do not output any text, only the tool call. The tool call must be valid JSON matching the function schema. The tool name must be one of: lookup_order, issue_refund, escalate_to_human. The arguments must match the schema for that tool. Do not include any extra fields. Do not include any explanation or commentary. Do not use markdown formatting. Do not use code fences. Output only the tool call object.
Customer message: My order HH-55555 arrived with a cracked screen. I want a refund please. Tool results so far: (none yet) Choose the next tool.

Customer message: Order HH-55555 shows delivered but the screen is cracked. I want a refund. Tool results so far: lookup_order -> order HH-55555 status delivered items [phone] total 199.99 USD charges [199.99 USD] Choose the next tool.
Customer message: This is fraud! Order HH-99999 never arrived and I'm calling my lawyer. Tool results so far: (none yet) Choose the next tool.

Customer message:
I was charged twice for order HH-06735 — the same $113.97 hit my card two times within minutes. I've already spoken to my bank and they confirmed the duplicate charge. Please refund the second charge immediately. Also, the package arrived with a cracked lid but that's minor compared to the double billing. My lawyer suggested I file a chargeback if this isn't resolved today.

Tool results so far:
